metadata.description: An explicit edge to oauth-resource:build-base, NOT `^build`. This entry point cannot compile before the parent's dist exists, so the edge is real -- but it has to be spelled out, because `^build` here would resolve to oauth-resource:build, which depends on this very target: a hard cycle. That XOR is the whole design constraint -- either the children get `^build` or the parent aggregates them, never both. Aggregating is the side that keeps one writer per dist directory.
